items.name: agent-chat
items.title: Agent chat
items.description: A streaming chat with the user's agent on camelRun: markdown, tool cards and generative UI, questions and approvals, files, stop, and scroll that follows the reply. Talks to a createAgentHandler route.

items.name: agent-markdown
items.title: Agent markdown
items.description: Safe, streaming-tolerant markdown for agent replies, rendered with elements (no raw HTML).

items.name: agent-route
items.title: Agent route (Next.js)
items.description: The Next.js App Router route the chat talks to: keeps your API key on the server and lets each user reach only their own agent.
